From First Measure to Final Press

A five-stage fitting, kept honest.

The same sequence for every commission — nothing rushed, nothing skipped.

00 IN

Consultation

We talk through occasion, wardrobe gaps and the silhouette you actually want.

14 IN

Cloth & Measure

Fabric selected from the book on file; every measurement logged to a personal chart.

28 IN

Cut & Baste

Pattern drafted and cloth cut, then hand-basted for the first fitting.

36 IN

Fitting

Shoulders, drape and break are checked and adjusted on the body, not the mannequin.

42 IN

Final Press

Finished, pressed and delivered — with the pattern kept on file for next time.
